five_required_answers.1_bulge_area: Same signed chord-closure area-density operator role, but raw normalization/carrier units differ. Status NORMALIZATION_DIFFERENT, not raw numeric identity.
five_required_answers.2_run_generators: Same run/turn alternation semantic source, but G multiplies by chord defect; A does not. Status ONLY_SEMANTIC_ROLE_MATCH.
five_required_answers.3_coefficient_drift: Not mainly explainable by frozen normalization alone. Normalization explains cross-arm coefficient magnitude non-comparability; within-arm radius drift requires changing motif statistics/covariance/finite-radius effects or true scale trajectory.
five_required_answers.4_dimensionless_common_vocabulary: Yes: signed area density*, run-switch density*, chord-defect ratio*, and their run-defect product form a low-complexity proposed common vocabulary. Proposal only.
five_required_answers.5_next_step: Continue larger-radius tests on frozen operators to diagnose within-arm convergence; separately test the dimensionless normalization as a new CROSS_ARM_INSPIRED_POST_SERIOUS_CHECKPOINT generation before any cross-arm coefficient-magnitude claim.
